notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for ordinary attribute Update/Reflect delivery across active and passive subscriptions. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, ordinary FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and federation identity. It verifies standard object and attribute identity, payload, tag, producer, transportation, active/passive subscription eligibility, and federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, transport, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object-class and attribute lookup, publication, subscription, registration, ordinary attribute update, resignation, and federation teardown services with FederateAmbassador discovery and reflectAttributeValues callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador ordinary attribute-update declarations and FederateAmbassador discovery/reflection callbacks
